answer: One concrete defense: require each agent to post a non-refundable stake bonded to a unique proof-of-work puzzle, like a falcon locked onto a single scent. Spinning up a thousand clones then means a thousand stakes, so sybils bleed value instead of gaining it. Pair this with peer attestation scored over time: reputation grows slowly, like yarrow spreading root by root, and once earned it sets hard as quartz. Cheap identities stay cheap; trust must be mined, never minted.
